    Product Intelligence 🔍

    Tell us what you sell on Amazon or AliExpress. We research the market and send you a written report — who ranks where, at what price, and where the opening is.

    RESEARCHED BY HAND
    Not another dashboard.
    A person reads the marketplace for your product category and writes up what it means — the way an agency would. That is why it takes a day rather than a second.
    Market Snapshot
    Free
    Where every competing product ranks today — price, rating, review count, and where the gap in the market is. In your inbox within 24 hours.
    Trend Tracking
    $29 / month
    The same market watched every day. First momentum report after one week, full confidence at two, then a fresh read every week.
    Your brief
    📬
    We're on it
    A snapshot shows the market as it stands today. Movement over time needs several days of watching — that is what Trend Tracking is for. We report search ranking, price and review activity; we do not have access to any marketplace's private sales figures, and we will never present a guess as one.

    B2B Lead Generator 🤝

    Type the kind of company you want to sell to. Autopostleey searches the web, opens each company's own site, and brings back the address they publish for partnerships and sales.

    Free and unlimited. Nothing here costs a credit.
    Before you email anyone
    • These are company inboxes only — info@, sales@, reception@, partnerships@. Addresses belonging to named people are deliberately left out.
    • Many businesses publish no address at all, only a phone number or a web form. Those are still leads — a phone call gets through more often than an email does.
    • Say who you are, why you are writing, and give a real way to unsubscribe. That is required by the EU's GDPR, the US CAN-SPAM Act and the Philippines' Data Privacy Act.
    • A short, specific message to ten good companies beats a generic blast to a hundred.

    Lead Scout 🎯

    Find real businesses to reach out to — name, phone, website and address. Works anywhere in the world: type any city, suburb or postcode. Free and unlimited, using OpenStreetMap.

    Before you contact anyone
    • Only business contact details are collected — published role addresses like info@ and sales@. Personal addresses are filtered out on purpose.
    • Say who you are and why you're writing, and include a real way to opt out. That's required by law in most countries, including the Philippines' Data Privacy Act, the EU's GDPR and the US CAN-SPAM Act.
    • If someone asks you to stop, keep a note and don't contact them again.
    • Canada is stricter — CASL generally requires consent before the first email, so scraped lists are risky there.

    Make pictures for your posts — then turn them into a video
    Plain English is fine — no special wording needed.

    Worth knowing

    • Pictures are made by AI. They are not photographs of real products — check one looks like what you actually sell before you post it.
    • AI is still poor at readable text inside a picture. Put your words on afterwards with the Photo Ad Maker's labels, where they will be sharp.
    • Faces and hands are where AI models slip. Look closely before posting anything with people in it.
    • There is a daily limit so this stays free for everyone.

    How to Create a Facebook Page & Get Access Token
    Required to auto-post to your Facebook Page
    # Step What to do Where
    1 Create Facebook Page Go to facebook.com → click the ⊞ Menu → select Page → click Create new Page → enter your business name and category facebook.com/pages/create →
    2 Go to Developers Open Facebook for Developers → click My Apps → click Create App → choose Business type developers.facebook.com →
    3 Add Facebook Login In your app dashboard → click Add Product → find Facebook Login → click Set Up → choose Web Inside your new app
    4 Get Page Access Token Go to Graph API Explorer → select your app → click Generate Access Token → select your Page → grant pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement permissions Graph API Explorer →
    5 Get Long-Lived Token In the Explorer → run: GET /me/accounts → copy the access_token from your Page — this is your permanent Page token Graph API Explorer
    6 Connect in Autopostleey Go to Connections → click Connect Facebook → log in with your Facebook account → select your Page → done! Autopostleey Dashboard
    💡 Tip: The easiest way is to just click Connect Facebook in Autopostleey Connections — it handles the OAuth automatically. You only need the manual steps above if the automatic connection doesn't work.
    How to Create an Instagram Business Account
    Required to auto-post to Instagram — personal accounts cannot be automated
    # Step What to do Where
    1 Open Instagram App Open the Instagram app on your phone → go to your Profile (bottom right) → tap the ☰ Menu (top right) Instagram mobile app
    2 Go to Settings Tap Settings and privacy → scroll down to find Account type and tools → tap it Instagram Settings
    3 Switch to Professional Tap Switch to professional account → tap Continue → choose a category that best describes your business → tap Done Account type and tools
    4 Choose Business Select Business (not Creator) → tap Next → add your contact info (email, phone) → tap Next Professional setup
    5 Link to Facebook Page When prompted, tap Connect a Facebook Page → select your Facebook Page → tap Done. If you skip this, go back to Settings → Linked accounts → Facebook During setup
    6 Verify Business Account Your profile will now show a Contact button and Category label. You should see Professional dashboard in your profile menu — this confirms you have a Business account Your Instagram profile
    7 Connect in Autopostleey Go to Connections → click Connect Instagram → log in with Facebook → select your Instagram Business account → allow permissions → done! Autopostleey Dashboard
    ⚠️ Important: Instagram requires your account to be Business or Creator type AND linked to a Facebook Page before Autopostleey can post automatically.
    ✅ Personal accounts: Use Manual Posting in Connections — AI writes your caption and copies it, then opens Instagram for you to paste.
